{{Otheruses|Treen}}
The '''Treen family''' hailed from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]]. Its member [[Haydnat Treen]] was a veteran [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of Kuat by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Lecersen Conspiracy]], working in the [[Galactic Alliance Senate]] on the Core World and [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where she had her own [[Haydnat Treen's apartments|apartments]] along with the family's [[BII Butler Droid]], [[Wyx]]. Her family's [[Color/Legends|colors]] were blue and gold.
